AlertDefinition.name: Pending Forecasts
AlertDefinition.Source: select f.forecastKey,s,f.item,r.responsibilityKey,coalesce(f.statusChangeDate,f.insertDate) from PcmAlertSubscription s, PcmForecast f, PcmResponsibility r where f.forecastType = 'COST' and f.status = 'PENDING' and f.forecastModel = 'ADJUSTABLE' and coalesce(f.statusChangeDate,f.insertDate) <= trunc(sysdate) - to_number(:days) and exists (select a.item from ItemAssignment a where a.item = f.item and s.user.userId = a.userId and s.alertType = 'ForecastPending' and s.subscribeFlag = 1

Detail.Label: @{name} alert for @{item}
Detail.Body: The item @{item} with responsibility @{responsibility} has a forecast pending since @{pendingSince}

List.name: ForecastPendingResponsibility
List.Expression: exists (select 1 from s.options o where o.optionId = 'Responsibility' and (lower(o.optionValue) = 'all' or lower(o.optionValue) = lower(a.responsibility)))

List.name: ForecastPendingDays
List.Expression: exists (select 1 from s.options o where o.optionId = 'PendingDays' and (o.optionValue = :days))

List.name: ForecastPendingSite
List.Expression: exists (select 1 from s.options o where o.optionId = 'Site' and (lower(o.optionValue) = 'all' or o.optionValue = to_char(f.site.siteKey)))
